Everything it needs, nothing it doesn’t

A small set of considered tools for presentation-ready images.

Backgrounds

Gradients, blob gradients, solid colors, system wallpapers and your own uploads.

Framing

Browser bar and OS mockups, padding and inset controls, rounded corners and borders.

Light and shadow

Shadow presets with custom tuning, plus rotation and positioning for the finishing touch.

Annotations

Pen and shape annotations to point at exactly what matters.

Watermark

Watermark text with position and offset controls, and an optional social-style prefix and badge.

Desktop-native

Custom keyboard shortcuts, native save dialogs, export scaling and quality, aspect ratio presets and auto-crop.

A small tool, made for a real problem

shotify began as a side project, built to stop the back-and-forth between apps just to make one screenshot presentable. Now it’s open source, for anyone who wants the same calm.

  • Open source, free to read and shape
  • macOS, Windows and Linux, built on a Tauri shell
  • One rendering pipeline shared by preview and export
  • What you see is exactly what you save

Make your next screenshot feel considered.
